definition: shaped like a circle, or going round and back to the start
sentence: The garden has a {circular} path around the fountain.
translation: В саду круговая дорожка вокруг фонтана.

definition: the movement of blood around the body, or of money, air or news
sentence: Exercise improves the {circulation} of blood to the brain.
translation: Упражнения улучшают кровообращение в мозге.

definition: the inner feeling that tells you whether what you do is right or wrong
sentence: His {conscience} would not let him keep the wallet he found.
translation: Совесть не позволила ему оставить найденный кошелёк.

definition: too many to be counted
sentence: She has told the story {countless} times.
translation: Она рассказывала эту историю бесчисленное количество раз.

definition: hard work and care given to something you believe in
sentence: Her {dedication} to the team never faded, even in defeat.
translation: Её преданность команде не угасала даже при поражении.

definition: being kept in a police station or prison, or kept after school as punishment
sentence: The suspect was held in {detention} for two days.
translation: Подозреваемого держали под стражей два дня.

definition: said or shown clearly, so nothing is left unclear
sentence: The teacher gave {explicit} instructions about the deadline.
translation: Учитель дал чёткие указания насчёт срока сдачи.

definition: in a clear and exact way
sentence: The contract {explicitly} forbids the sale of the data.
translation: Договор прямо запрещает продажу данных.

definition: an illness like a bad cold with a fever and aching body
sentence: Half the office is off with the {flu} this week.
translation: На этой неделе половина офиса болеет гриппом.

definition: soldiers who fight on foot
sentence: The {infantry} moved forward behind the tanks.
translation: Пехота двигалась вперёд за танками.

definition: necessary as part of a whole
sentence: Music is an {integral} part of every festival in the town.
translation: Музыка — неотъемлемая часть каждого праздника в городе.

definition: with little force or weight, or without serious thought
sentence: She touched his arm {lightly} to wake him.
translation: Она легонько коснулась его руки, чтобы разбудить.

definition: connected with the sea, ships or sailing
sentence: The museum tells the {maritime} history of the port.
translation: Музей рассказывает о морской истории порта.

definition: the box, paper or plastic that goods are wrapped in
sentence: The toy came in so much {packaging} that it filled the bin.
translation: Игрушка пришла в такой куче упаковки, что та заполнила всё ведро.

definition: relating to the areas around the North or South Pole
sentence: The {polar} ice is melting faster than scientists expected.
translation: Полярный лёд тает быстрее, чем ожидали учёные.

definition: famous and admired for something
sentence: The city is {renowned} for its fish market and its bridges.
translation: Город известен своим рыбным рынком и мостами.

definition: in a way that relates to society or to meeting people
sentence: They know each other {socially} but have never worked together.
translation: Они знакомы по общим компаниям, но никогда не работали вместе.

definition: by a large amount or degree
sentence: The new engine is {substantially} quieter than the old one.
translation: Новый двигатель существенно тише старого.

definition: of excellent quality, very good
sentence: The hotel served a {superb} breakfast with fresh fruit.
translation: В отеле подавали превосходный завтрак со свежими фруктами.

definition: according to what people say, though it may not be true
sentence: The castle is {supposedly} haunted by an old queen.
translation: Замок, как говорят, населён призраком старой королевы.

definition: belonging to them
sentence: Our garden is small, but {theirs} is huge.
translation: Наш сад маленький, а их — огромный.

definition: clothes worn next to the skin under other clothes
sentence: Pack enough {underwear} for a week away.
translation: Возьми достаточно нижнего белья на неделю.

definition: able to work successfully or to survive
sentence: Without a bank loan the plan is simply not {viable}.
translation: Без банковского кредита план просто нежизнеспособен.

definition: the narrow part of the body between the chest and the hips
sentence: The skirt was too tight at the {waist}.
translation: Юбка была слишком тесной в талии.

definition: to push someone or something roughly
sentence: Someone tried to {shove} me out of the queue.
translation: Кто-то попытался вытолкнуть меня из очереди.

definition: the first model of something new, used to test the design
sentence: The team built a {prototype} of the bike in just three weeks.
translation: Команда построила прототип велосипеда всего за три недели.

definition: the period of holding an important job, or a permanent job at a university
sentence: During her {tenure} as mayor, the city built two new schools.
translation: За время её пребывания на посту мэра город построил две новые школы.

definition: relating to young people who are not yet adults, or silly and childish
sentence: The case was heard in a {juvenile} court because the boy was fifteen.
translation: Дело рассматривал суд по делам несовершеннолетних, так как мальчику было пятнадцать.

definition: a climbing plant, especially the one that produces grapes
sentence: A {vine} grew up the wall and across the window.
translation: Лоза взбиралась по стене и тянулась через окно.

definition: to push something quickly with a finger or a stick
sentence: Don't {poke} the fire with your hand; use the iron bar.
translation: Не тычь в огонь рукой, возьми железный прут.

definition: a man of the lowest rank of nobility, or a very powerful businessman
sentence: The oil {baron} bought three newspapers in one year.
translation: Нефтяной магнат купил три газеты за один год.

definition: kings, queens and their families, or money paid to an author for each copy sold
sentence: The hotel has hosted {royalty} from all over Europe.
translation: В отеле останавливались члены королевских семей со всей Европы.

definition: something that causes a reaction or makes something grow
sentence: Lower taxes were meant as a {stimulus} for the economy.
translation: Снижение налогов задумывалось как стимул для экономики.

definition: a person who organises the different parts of an activity so they work together
sentence: The event {coordinator} booked the hall and the band.
translation: Координатор мероприятия забронировал зал и группу.

definition: a book or film with an exciting story about crime or danger
sentence: I read the {thriller} in one night because I had to know the ending.
translation: Я прочитал триллер за одну ночь, потому что должен был узнать конец.

definition: very strong, with a lot of force or bad feeling
sentence: There was a {fierce} argument about who should pay.
translation: Разгорелся яростный спор о том, кто должен платить.

definition: a large white bird with a long neck that lives on lakes and rivers
sentence: A {swan} glided across the lake towards the bread.
translation: Лебедь скользил по озеру к хлебу.

definition: a line of rocks or coral just below the surface of the sea
sentence: The boat hit a {reef} and began to take in water.
translation: Лодка налетела на риф и начала набирать воду.

definition: a folding frame covered with cloth that you hold over your head in the rain
sentence: Take an {umbrella}, the sky looks dark in the west.
translation: Возьми зонт, небо на западе выглядит тёмным.

definition: a soft round fruit with yellow-pink skin and a large stone inside
sentence: The {peach} was so ripe that juice ran down my chin.
translation: Персик был таким спелым, что сок тёк по подбородку.

definition: a class or meeting in which a small group discusses a subject
sentence: The professor leads a {seminar} on modern poetry every Thursday.
translation: Профессор ведёт семинар по современной поэзии каждый четверг.

definition: a device that puts electricity back into a battery
sentence: I left my phone {charger} at the hotel.
translation: Я оставил зарядку от телефона в отеле.

definition: a person or bank that lends money
sentence: The {lender} agreed to lower the interest rate on the loan.
translation: Кредитор согласился снизить процентную ставку по кредиту.

definition: an official order given by a ruler or government
sentence: The king signed a {decree} that closed the borders.
translation: Король подписал указ о закрытии границ.

definition: the act of putting a dead body into the ground
sentence: The {burial} took place in the village where he was born.
translation: Погребение состоялось в деревне, где он родился.

definition: to show something clearly, especially a feeling or quality
sentence: Her anger began to {manifest} itself in long silences.
translation: Её гнев начал проявляться в долгом молчании.

definition: a woman whose job is to clean rooms in a house or hotel
sentence: The {maid} left fresh towels on the bed every morning.
translation: Горничная каждое утро оставляла на кровати свежие полотенца.

definition: a song that is the official song of a country or group
sentence: Everyone stood for the national {anthem} before the match.
translation: Перед матчем все встали для исполнения государственного гимна.

definition: a signal for someone to do something, or a long stick used in billiards
sentence: The actor missed his {cue} and came on stage too late.
translation: Актёр пропустил свою реплику-сигнал и вышел на сцену слишком поздно.

definition: to have such a strong effect that someone cannot cope
sentence: The number of emails began to {overwhelm} the small team.
translation: Количество писем стало захлёстывать маленькую команду.

definition: an idea that is suggested as an explanation and then tested
sentence: The experiment was designed to test the {hypothesis} about sleep.
translation: Эксперимент был задуман для проверки гипотезы о сне.

definition: to be or do better than someone or something
sentence: Sales this year will {surpass} last year's record.
translation: Продажи в этом году превзойдут прошлогодний рекорд.

definition: a fixed idea about what a type of person is like
sentence: Not every programmer fits the {stereotype} of a quiet guy.
translation: Не каждый программист соответствует стереотипу тихони.

definition: a man who is a member of the police
sentence: A {policeman} stopped the traffic to let the children cross.
translation: Полицейский остановил движение, чтобы дети перешли дорогу.

definition: to close and open your eyes very quickly
sentence: The light was so bright that I had to {blink}.
translation: Свет был таким ярким, что мне пришлось моргнуть.

definition: an unfair dislike of a group of people formed without good reason
sentence: There's still a lot of {prejudice} against people with accents.
translation: Предвзятости к людям с акцентом по-прежнему много.

definition: to look at something carefully to check it
sentence: An engineer will {inspect} the bridge every six months.
translation: Инженер будет осматривать мост каждые полгода.

definition: to feel and show great sadness because someone has died
sentence: The whole town came out to {mourn} the old teacher.
translation: Весь город вышел оплакивать старого учителя.

definition: to behave as if you are attracted to someone, in a playful way
sentence: He likes to {flirt} with the waitresses, but it means nothing.
translation: Он любит флиртовать с официантками, но это ничего не значит.

definition: very weak and hard to see, hear or smell
sentence: I heard a {faint} noise from the basement.
translation: Я услышал слабый шум из подвала.

definition: a shop or part of a hospital where medicines are prepared and sold
sentence: The {pharmacy} on the corner is open until midnight.
translation: Аптека на углу открыта до полуночи.

definition: a long period with little or no rain
sentence: After three months of {drought}, the river was almost dry.
translation: После трёх месяцев засухи река почти пересохла.

definition: a large container with a handle for pouring drinks, or the baseball player who throws
sentence: She put a {pitcher} of cold lemonade on the table.
translation: Она поставила на стол кувшин холодного лимонада.

definition: a dead body, usually of a person
sentence: The {corpse} was found in the river two days later.
translation: Тело нашли в реке два дня спустя.

definition: to think that something is true although you are not sure
sentence: I {presume} you've already eaten, so I didn't cook.
translation: Я предположил, что ты уже поел, и ничего не готовил.

definition: so unreasonable that it seems silly or funny
sentence: It is {absurd} to pay that much for a cup of coffee.
translation: Платить столько за чашку кофе — нелепо.

definition: wanting very much to be successful, or needing a lot of effort to succeed
sentence: She is {ambitious} and plans to run the company one day.
translation: Она амбициозна и планирует однажды возглавить компанию.

definition: a type of dancing with careful set movements, usually telling a story
sentence: Her daughter has {ballet} lessons twice a week.
translation: Её дочь занимается балетом дважды в неделю.

definition: a strong feeling of sympathy for people who suffer and a wish to help
sentence: The nurse treated every patient with {compassion}.
translation: Медсестра относилась к каждому пациенту с состраданием.

definition: official papers or written instructions about something
sentence: Keep the {documentation} for the car in the glove box.
translation: Храни документы на машину в бардачке.

definition: suddenly and to a great degree, or in a theatrical way
sentence: House prices fell {dramatically} after the factory closed.
translation: Цены на жильё резко упали после закрытия завода.

definition: beautiful in a simple and stylish way
sentence: She wore an {elegant} black dress to the opera.
translation: Она надела элегантное чёрное платье в оперу.

definition: the country where you were born or where you belong
sentence: After thirty years abroad, he returned to his {homeland}.
translation: После тридцати лет за границей он вернулся на родину.

definition: in or involving several countries
sentence: The band is now known {internationally}, not just at home.
translation: Группа теперь известна во всём мире, а не только дома.

definition: weak and unconvincing, or unable to walk properly because of an injured leg
sentence: He gave a {lame} excuse for missing the meeting.
translation: Он привёл слабое оправдание тому, что пропустил встречу.

definition: the main part of a country or continent, not its islands
sentence: The ferry to the {mainland} runs twice a day.
translation: Паром на материк ходит дважды в день.

definition: relating to deep questions about life, or calm about problems
sentence: He was {philosophical} about losing the match and shrugged.
translation: Он отнёсся к проигрышу по-философски и пожал плечами.

definition: the yellow liquid part of blood, or a very hot form of gas
sentence: Doctors gave the patient {plasma} after the accident.
translation: После аварии врачи ввели пациенту плазму.

definition: speech or writing that sounds impressive but may be empty
sentence: The speech was full of {rhetoric} but offered no real plan.
translation: Речь была полна красивых слов, но не предлагала реального плана.

definition: being saved from harm or sin, or something that saves you
sentence: The new job was his {salvation} after two hard years.
translation: Новая работа стала его спасением после двух тяжёлых лет.

definition: not connected with religion
sentence: The school is {secular}, so there are no prayers in the morning.
translation: Школа светская, поэтому утренних молитв нет.

definition: the number 16
sentence: She learned to drive when she was {sixteen}.
translation: Она научилась водить, когда ей было шестнадцать.

definition: made by people from chemicals, not natural
sentence: The jacket is made of a {synthetic} material that dries fast.
translation: Куртка сделана из синтетического материала, который быстро сохнет.

definition: nervous and unable to relax, or making people feel that way
sentence: The room went {tense} when the results were read out.
translation: В комнате стало напряжённо, когда зачитали результаты.

definition: a wild area where no people live and nothing is farmed
sentence: They walked for a week through the {wilderness} without seeing a road.
translation: Они неделю шли по дикой местности, не увидев ни одной дороги.

definition: a person you share a room or flat with
sentence: My {roommate} plays guitar until two in the morning.
translation: Мой сосед по комнате играет на гитаре до двух ночи.

definition: text at the top of a page, or hitting a ball with your head
sentence: Put the date in the {header} of every page.
translation: Поставь дату в верхнем колонтитуле каждой страницы.

definition: to stick things together with a sticky substance
sentence: You can {glue} the broken handle back onto the cup.
translation: Можно приклеить отломанную ручку обратно к чашке.

definition: to do what a person, law or rule tells you to do
sentence: The dog will {obey} only its owner.
translation: Собака слушается только своего хозяина.

definition: a drink of any kind, used in formal language
sentence: Hot {beverages} are served in the lounge after six.
translation: Горячие напитки подают в зале после шести.

definition: the taste of a food or drink
sentence: The soup has a strong {flavour} of garlic.
translation: У супа сильный привкус чеснока.

definition: a short sleep during the day
sentence: Grandpa takes a {nap} after lunch every day.
translation: Дедушка каждый день спит после обеда.

definition: something that takes your attention away from what you are doing
sentence: The phone is a constant {distraction} when I try to study.
translation: Телефон постоянно отвлекает, когда я пытаюсь учиться.

definition: to join the army, or to get someone's help
sentence: He decided to {enlist} in the navy at eighteen.
translation: В восемнадцать он решил пойти служить на флот.

definition: to make clothes from wool using two long needles
sentence: My aunt taught me to {knit} a scarf last winter.
translation: Прошлой зимой тётя научила меня вязать шарф.

definition: the slow process of becoming bad, weak or rotten
sentence: Sugar causes tooth {decay} if you do not brush.
translation: Сахар вызывает разрушение зубов, если не чистить их.

definition: something that comes from another thing, or a financial contract based on another asset
sentence: The bank lost money on a {derivative} tied to oil prices.
translation: Банк потерял деньги на производном контракте, привязанном к ценам на нефть.

definition: a change in the genes of a living thing
sentence: A single {mutation} made the virus spread faster.
translation: Одна мутация заставила вирус распространяться быстрее.

definition: to feel like doing something, or to slope or lean
sentence: I {incline} to agree with you, but let me check the numbers.
translation: Я склонен согласиться с тобой, но дай проверить цифры.

definition: an area of low wet land, often near a river or the sea
sentence: Thousands of birds nest in the {marsh} every spring.
translation: Каждую весну тысячи птиц гнездятся на болоте.

definition: a small figure moved by strings or a hand, or a person others control
sentence: The children watched a {puppet} show in the park.
translation: Дети смотрели кукольный спектакль в парке.

definition: to make two devices or files hold the same information
sentence: The app will {sync} your photos to the cloud every night.
translation: Приложение будет синхронизировать фотографии с облаком каждую ночь.

definition: to clean something by rubbing it hard with a brush
sentence: You will need to {scrub} the pan to get the burnt rice off.
translation: Придётся оттирать сковороду, чтобы отчистить пригоревший рис.

definition: the total amount of money spent on something
sentence: Public {expenditure} on roads doubled in five years.
translation: Государственные расходы на дороги удвоились за пять лет.

definition: sweet food eaten at the end of a meal
sentence: For {dessert} there is apple pie with ice cream.
translation: На десерт яблочный пирог с мороженым.

definition: a small ball of glass, wood or plastic with a hole, strung on a thread
sentence: She lost a red {bead} from her necklace on the bus.
translation: Она потеряла красную бусину с ожерелья в автобусе.

definition: certain to die one day, or causing death
sentence: All of us are {mortal}, so use your time well.
translation: Все мы смертны, так что используй своё время с толком.

definition: a special court that decides a particular kind of dispute
sentence: The {tribunal} ruled that she had been fired unfairly.
translation: Трибунал постановил, что её уволили несправедливо.

definition: a small simple building with one room, often of wood
sentence: The climbers slept in a wooden {hut} below the peak.
translation: Альпинисты ночевали в деревянной хижине под вершиной.

definition: to push something suddenly and hard
sentence: He {thrust} the letter into my hand and ran off.
translation: Он сунул мне в руку письмо и убежал.

definition: to travel often between two places
sentence: The bus will {shuttle} guests between the hotel and the airport.
translation: Автобус будет возить гостей между отелем и аэропортом.

definition: a safe place away from danger or trouble
sentence: The cave gave the hikers {refuge} from the storm.
translation: Пещера дала туристам укрытие от бури.

definition: a metal rod or wire that sends or receives radio signals
sentence: The {antenna} on the roof picks up stations from the coast.
translation: Антенна на крыше ловит станции с побережья.

definition: a person who directs an orchestra, or a material that electricity passes through
sentence: The {conductor} raised her arms and the music began.
translation: Дирижёр подняла руки, и музыка началась.

definition: all the bones of a body, or the basic frame of something
sentence: The museum has the {skeleton} of a whale hanging from the ceiling.
translation: В музее под потолком висит скелет кита.

definition: a place where young children are cared for, or where plants are grown
sentence: She drops the baby at the {nursery} on her way to work.
translation: Она отвозит малыша в ясли по дороге на работу.

definition: a dishonest or badly behaved person, often in a charming way
sentence: The old {rogue} sold the same horse to three buyers.
translation: Старый мошенник продал одну и ту же лошадь трём покупателям.

definition: an extremely famous performer or sports player
sentence: The young striker became a {superstar} in a single season.
translation: Молодой нападающий стал суперзвездой за один сезон.

definition: a long thin piece of cloth used to tie or make something pretty
sentence: She tied a blue {ribbon} around the gift.
translation: Она перевязала подарок голубой лентой.

definition: a poor farmer with a small piece of land, especially in the past
sentence: The {peasant} worked the land from dawn to dusk.
translation: Крестьянин работал на земле от рассвета до заката.

definition: to move people out of a dangerous place
sentence: Police had to {evacuate} the building after the gas leak.
translation: Полиции пришлось эвакуировать людей из здания после утечки газа.

definition: a person whose job is to work with scientific or technical equipment
sentence: A {technician} came to repair the lab's freezer.
translation: Техник пришёл починить морозильник в лаборатории.

definition: to forgive someone officially for a crime
sentence: The president may {pardon} the prisoner before leaving office.
translation: Президент может помиловать заключённого до ухода с поста.

definition: a small soft red fruit with tiny seeds on its skin
sentence: We picked a basket of {strawberries} at the farm.
translation: Мы собрали корзину клубники на ферме.

definition: any kind of cloth made in a factory
sentence: The town grew rich on the {textile} trade in the 1800s.
translation: Город разбогател на торговле тканями в 1800-х годах.

definition: the structure of the body, or the study of it
sentence: Medical students learn {anatomy} in their first year.
translation: Студенты-медики изучают анатомию на первом курсе.

definition: a board game for two players with sixteen pieces each
sentence: My grandfather taught me to play {chess} when I was six.
translation: Дедушка научил меня играть в шахматы, когда мне было шесть.

definition: as a result
sentence: The bridge was closed; {consequently}, the journey took twice as long.
translation: Мост был закрыт, и в результате дорога заняла вдвое больше времени.

definition: not interesting at all, so you want to stop watching or listening
sentence: The film was so {dull} that I fell asleep.
translation: Фильм был такой скучный, что я уснул.

definition: not right or not true
sentence: Two of your answers were {incorrect}, so you scored eight.
translation: Два твоих ответа были неверными, так что ты набрал восемь.

definition: the best possible in a particular situation
sentence: The {optimal} time to plant tomatoes here is early May.
translation: Оптимальное время для посадки помидоров здесь — начало мая.

definition: time worked beyond the normal hours, or extra time in a game
sentence: She earns extra money by working {overtime} on weekends.
translation: Она подрабатывает сверхурочно по выходным.

definition: relating to the sending of letters and parcels
sentence: Write your {postal} address clearly on the form.
translation: Чётко напиши свой почтовый адрес в анкете.

definition: very great, deep or strong in its effect
sentence: Her advice had a {profound} effect on my life.
translation: Её совет оказал глубокое влияние на мою жизнь.

definition: involving the chance of harm or loss
sentence: Climbing without a rope is too {risky} for beginners.
translation: Подниматься без верёвки слишком рискованно для новичков.

definition: strong and healthy, or unlikely to break or fail
sentence: The new phone case is {robust} enough to survive a drop.
translation: Новый чехол для телефона достаточно прочный, чтобы выдержать падение.

definition: watching over a person or activity to make sure all is done properly
sentence: Children may use the pool only under adult {supervision}.
translation: Дети могут пользоваться бассейном только под присмотром взрослых.

definition: a type of land and its surface features
sentence: The {terrain} is rocky, so wear strong boots.
translation: Местность каменистая, так что надень крепкие ботинки.

definition: a group of three people or things, especially musicians
sentence: A jazz {trio} played in the corner of the restaurant.
translation: Джазовое трио играло в углу ресторана.

definition: in a state like sleep because of injury or illness, or not aware
sentence: He was knocked {unconscious} by the falling branch.
translation: Падающая ветка оглушила его до потери сознания.

definition: all the people who work in a company or country
sentence: Women make up half of the hospital's {workforce}.
translation: Женщины составляют половину персонала больницы.

definition: to make something last longer
sentence: The doctors did everything to {prolong} his life.
translation: Врачи сделали всё, чтобы продлить ему жизнь.

definition: a person whose job is to keep and check financial records
sentence: Our {accountant} says we paid too much tax last year.
translation: Наш бухгалтер говорит, что в прошлом году мы заплатили слишком много налогов.

definition: food used to catch fish or animals, or anything used to tempt someone
sentence: He put a worm on the hook as {bait}.
translation: Он насадил червяка на крючок в качестве наживки.

definition: a person who rides a bicycle
sentence: A {cyclist} was hurt when a car door opened in front of her.
translation: Велосипедистка пострадала, когда перед ней открылась дверь машины.

definition: a small printed sheet advertising something, handed out in the street
sentence: Someone pushed a {flyer} for the new pizza place under the door.
translation: Кто-то подсунул под дверь листовку новой пиццерии.

definition: to be at one or both sides of something
sentence: Two guards {flank} the gate day and night.
translation: Двое охранников стоят по обе стороны ворот днём и ночью.

definition: a precious stone, or a very valuable thing or person
sentence: The crown is set with a {jewel} the size of an egg.
translation: Корона украшена драгоценным камнем размером с яйцо.

definition: to join two things so they become one
sentence: Heat will {fuse} the two pieces of plastic together.
translation: Тепло сплавит два куска пластика вместе.

definition: to make a new version of an old film, song or product
sentence: The studio plans to {remake} the classic film with new stars.
translation: Студия планирует переснять классический фильм с новыми звёздами.

definition: to move or be passed around among a group of people
sentence: Please {circulate} the report to everyone before the meeting.
translation: Пожалуйста, разошли отчёт всем до совещания.

definition: a medicine that kills the tiny living things that cause an illness
sentence: The doctor gave her an {antibiotic} for the chest infection.
translation: Врач назначил ей антибиотик от инфекции в груди.

definition: a box-shaped part of a piece of furniture that slides out
sentence: The spoons are in the top {drawer} next to the sink.
translation: Ложки в верхнем ящике рядом с раковиной.

definition: a large shop that sells food and goods for the home
sentence: I stopped at the {supermarket} to buy milk and bread.
translation: Я зашёл в супермаркет купить молока и хлеба.

definition: a very thin layer of skin or material that covers or separates things
sentence: Oxygen passes through the {membrane} of each cell.
translation: Кислород проходит через мембрану каждой клетки.

definition: to move so that one side is higher than the other
sentence: {Tilt} the screen a little so the light does not reflect.
translation: Наклони экран немного, чтобы свет не отражался.

definition: to keep someone at a police station or prison, or to delay them
sentence: Police may {detain} a suspect for up to 24 hours.
translation: Полиция может задержать подозреваемого на срок до 24 часов.

definition: something you cannot stop thinking about
sentence: Football has become an {obsession} for my son.
translation: Футбол стал навязчивой идеей моего сына.

definition: a curve that winds round and round, moving away from the centre
sentence: The staircase rose in a {spiral} to the top of the tower.
translation: Лестница поднималась спиралью к вершине башни.

definition: money given to a researcher, or a friendly group with shared interests
sentence: She won a {fellowship} to study insects in Brazil.
translation: Она получила стипендию на изучение насекомых в Бразилии.

definition: a small truck with an open back, or the act of collecting someone or something
sentence: He drove the {pickup} to the farm with a load of hay.
translation: Он отвёз на пикапе сено на ферму.

definition: a person who cannot stop taking a drug or doing an activity
sentence: The clinic helps every {addict} who asks for treatment.
translation: Клиника помогает каждому зависимому, кто просит лечения.

definition: hard to bend or move, or very formal
sentence: My neck is {stiff} from sleeping on the plane.
translation: У меня затекла шея после сна в самолёте.

definition: to love someone or something very much
sentence: The children {adore} their grandmother and her stories.
translation: Дети обожают бабушку и её истории.

definition: a male member of the US Congress
sentence: The {congressman} promised to vote against the new tax.
translation: Конгрессмен пообещал голосовать против нового налога.

definition: to say something or make a sound
sentence: She did not {utter} a word during the whole meeting.
translation: За всё совещание она не проронила ни слова.

definition: to close something with a fastener of two rows of teeth
sentence: {Zip} your jacket up, it is freezing outside.
translation: Застегни куртку на молнию, на улице мороз.

definition: a former student of a school or university
sentence: As an {alumnus}, he gives money to the college every year.
translation: Как выпускник, он каждый год жертвует деньги колледжу.

definition: a narrow street between or behind buildings
sentence: The cat disappeared down a dark {alley} behind the shops.
translation: Кошка скрылась в тёмном переулке за магазинами.

definition: to grow plants on land, or to develop a skill or relationship
sentence: Farmers here {cultivate} rice on the wet lower fields.
translation: Здешние фермеры выращивают рис на влажных нижних полях.

definition: a company that supplies goods to shops from the makers
sentence: The {distributor} delivers to every shop in the region twice a week.
translation: Дистрибьютор дважды в неделю доставляет товар во все магазины региона.

definition: the part of a song repeated after each verse, or a group of singers
sentence: Everyone joined in when the {chorus} came round.
translation: Все подхватили, когда дошло до припева.

definition: a promise that something is true or will happen
sentence: He gave me his {assurance} that the money would arrive on Monday.
translation: Он заверил меня, что деньги придут в понедельник.

definition: a Japanese fighter in the past trained to move secretly, or an expert
sentence: He moved through the dark house like a {ninja}.
translation: Он двигался по тёмному дому, как ниндзя.

definition: a tall post of stone or wood that holds up a roof
sentence: The roof rests on six marble {pillars}.
translation: Крыша опирается на шесть мраморных колонн.

definition: the ability to make good decisions, or a decision made by a court
sentence: Trust your own {judgement} when choosing a flat.
translation: Доверяй собственному суждению, выбирая квартиру.

definition: the act of refusing to accept something or someone
sentence: She got a {rejection} from the first three publishers.
translation: Первые три издательства ей отказали.

definition: a tool for opening cans or bottles, or the first item in a series
sentence: Hand me the bottle {opener} from the drawer.
translation: Подай мне открывалку из ящика.

definition: a judge in a local court who deals with less serious crimes
sentence: The {magistrate} fined him for parking on the pavement.
translation: Мировой судья оштрафовал его за парковку на тротуаре.

definition: the group of people attending a church service
sentence: The {congregation} stood up and sang the first hymn.
translation: Прихожане встали и запели первый гимн.

definition: relating to cars and the car industry
sentence: Thousands of {automotive} jobs depend on the new factory.
translation: Тысячи рабочих мест в автомобильной отрасли зависят от нового завода.

definition: a word like 'and' or 'but' that joins parts of a sentence, or a combination
sentence: 'Because' is a {conjunction} that gives a reason.
translation: «Because» — союз, который указывает причину.

definition: costing a lot of money, or causing a lot of loss
sentence: Fixing the roof will be {costly}, but waiting will cost more.
translation: Ремонт крыши обойдётся дорого, но ждать выйдет ещё дороже.

definition: the act of going down, or your family origins
sentence: The {descent} from the summit took longer than the climb.
translation: Спуск с вершины занял больше времени, чем подъём.

definition: the act of removing something completely, or being knocked out of a contest
sentence: The {elimination} of the team in the first round shocked the fans.
translation: Вылет команды в первом раунде шокировал болельщиков.

definition: a hot-tasting root used as a spice, or a reddish-yellow colour
sentence: Add fresh {ginger} and garlic to the hot oil.
translation: Добавь свежий имбирь и чеснок в горячее масло.

definition: the process of making pictures of the inside of the body or of objects
sentence: Medical {imaging} showed a small crack in the bone.
translation: Медицинская визуализация показала небольшую трещину в кости.

definition: the fact of not being able to do something
sentence: His {inability} to say no leaves him with too much work.
translation: Его неспособность отказать оставляет ему слишком много работы.

definition: arriving, or about to start a job after someone else
sentence: All {incoming} calls are recorded for training.
translation: Все входящие звонки записываются для обучения.

definition: the process of taking a disagreement to a court of law
sentence: The company spent millions on {litigation} over the patent.
translation: Компания потратила миллионы на судебные тяжбы из-за патента.

definition: goods that are bought and sold, especially items linked to a band or team
sentence: The band sells {merchandise} like T-shirts after every show.
translation: Группа продаёт мерч вроде футболок после каждого концерта.

definition: following the traditional and accepted beliefs or methods
sentence: His {orthodox} approach to teaching leaves no room for games.
translation: Его традиционный подход к обучению не оставляет места играм.

definition: above your head, or relating to the general costs of running a business
sentence: Put your bag in the {overhead} locker before take-off.
translation: Положи сумку в верхнюю полку перед взлётом.

definition: likely to suffer from or do something bad
sentence: Old wooden houses are {prone} to fire.
translation: Старые деревянные дома подвержены пожарам.

definition: quickly and willingly, without any problem
sentence: She {readily} agreed to swap shifts with me.
translation: Она с готовностью согласилась поменяться со мной сменами.

definition: the return of something to life, strength or popularity
sentence: The town saw a {revival} after the railway reopened.
translation: Город возродился после возобновления работы железной дороги.

definition: surrounding a city or building with soldiers to force it to give up
sentence: The castle survived a {siege} that lasted all winter.
translation: Замок выдержал осаду, длившуюся всю зиму.

definition: relating to sound or the speed of sound
sentence: The jet broke the {sonic} barrier over the desert.
translation: Самолёт преодолел звуковой барьер над пустыней.

definition: pleased and relieved that something good happened
sentence: We were {thankful} that the storm passed without damage.
translation: Мы были благодарны, что буря прошла без ущерба.

definition: the person who looks after the money of a club or organisation
sentence: The club's {treasurer} reads the accounts at every meeting.
translation: Казначей клуба зачитывает отчёт о расходах на каждом собрании.

definition: not easy to understand, or not certain
sentence: It is still {unclear} who will replace the manager.
translation: Пока неясно, кто заменит менеджера.

definition: supporting an extreme right-wing system of strict control and nationalism
sentence: The {fascist} regime banned all other parties.
translation: Фашистский режим запретил все остальные партии.

definition: a person who has more than a billion dollars or pounds
sentence: The {billionaire} bought the football club as a present for himself.
translation: Миллиардер купил футбольный клуб в подарок самому себе.

definition: a basic food eaten regularly, or a small metal wire that holds papers together
sentence: Rice is the {staple} of most meals in the region.
translation: Рис — основа большинства блюд в этом регионе.

definition: a detailed judgement of a book, film, idea or piece of work
sentence: The professor wrote a sharp {critique} of the new theory.
translation: Профессор написал резкий критический разбор новой теории.

definition: a group of people who sing together, especially in a church or school
sentence: She sings in the school {choir} every Friday.
translation: Она поёт в школьном хоре каждую пятницу.

definition: a chain or string of beads worn around the neck
sentence: He gave her a gold {necklace} for their anniversary.
translation: На годовщину он подарил ей золотое ожерелье.

definition: to bring people together again after they were apart
sentence: The charity works to {reunite} lost children with their parents.
translation: Организация помогает воссоединить потерявшихся детей с родителями.

definition: a very short person, or a small creature in old stories
sentence: In the story, a {dwarf} guards the gold under the mountain.
translation: В сказке гном сторожит золото под горой.

definition: to push the loose end of something into a tight place
sentence: {Tuck} your shirt into your trousers before the photo.
translation: Заправь рубашку в брюки перед фотографией.

definition: a connection between two things in which one changes with the other
sentence: There is a clear {correlation} between sleep and exam results.
translation: Есть явная связь между сном и результатами экзаменов.

definition: a violent storm with very strong winds spinning in a circle
sentence: The {tornado} tore the roof off the school.
translation: Торнадо сорвал крышу со школы.

definition: a shop where you can have your hair or nails done
sentence: She spends every Saturday morning at the hair {salon}.
translation: Каждое субботнее утро она проводит в парикмахерской.

definition: a university student who has not yet taken a first degree
sentence: As an {undergraduate}, he studied physics in Manchester.
translation: Будучи студентом, он изучал физику в Манчестере.

definition: a person trained to help people with their problems
sentence: The school {counselor} helped him cope with his parents' divorce.
translation: Школьный психолог помог ему справиться с разводом родителей.

definition: to wind something into a series of circles
sentence: {Coil} the rope so it does not tangle on the deck.
translation: Смотай верёвку кольцами, чтобы она не запуталась на палубе.

definition: to officially end a law, system or practice
sentence: The country decided to {abolish} the death penalty in 1998.
translation: В 1998 году страна решила отменить смертную казнь.

definition: a person who listens, especially to the radio
sentence: One {listener} called the station to thank the host.
translation: Один слушатель позвонил на радио, чтобы поблагодарить ведущего.

definition: a long orange vegetable that grows under the ground
sentence: Grate a {carrot} into the salad for colour.
translation: Натри морковь в салат для цвета.

definition: to frighten someone so that they do what you want
sentence: The gang tried to {intimidate} the witness before the trial.
translation: Банда пыталась запугать свидетеля перед судом.

definition: to cover a road or path with flat stones or concrete
sentence: Workers will {pave} the path to the school next month.
translation: В следующем месяце рабочие замостят дорожку к школе.

definition: a town or part of a large city with its own local government
sentence: Each {borough} of the city runs its own schools.
translation: Каждый округ города сам управляет своими школами.

definition: to bring food back up from the stomach through the mouth
sentence: The boat rocked so much that two passengers began to {vomit}.
translation: Лодку так качало, что двоих пассажиров стало тошнить.

definition: a person who shoots with a bow and arrows
sentence: The {archer} hit the centre of the target three times in a row.
translation: Лучник трижды подряд попал в центр мишени.

definition: a small type of horse
sentence: The children took turns riding the {pony} around the field.
translation: Дети по очереди катались на пони по полю.

definition: a large group of animals of one kind that live together
sentence: A {herd} of cows blocked the road for ten minutes.
translation: Стадо коров перегородило дорогу на десять минут.

definition: willing to help and work with others
sentence: The witness was {cooperative} and answered every question.
translation: Свидетель охотно сотрудничал и ответил на каждый вопрос.

definition: a hard pink or white material made by tiny sea animals
sentence: Warm seas are killing the {coral} along the coast.
translation: Тёплые моря губят кораллы вдоль побережья.

definition: a large expensive boat used for pleasure or racing
sentence: They spent the summer sailing a {yacht} around the Greek islands.
translation: Они провели лето, плавая на яхте вокруг греческих островов.

definition: to stop or catch something before it reaches where it was going
sentence: The defender managed to {intercept} the pass and run upfield.
translation: Защитник сумел перехватить пас и побежал вперёд.

definition: a large brown nut with hard shell, white inside and sweet water
sentence: He cracked the {coconut} open with a stone.
translation: Он расколол кокос камнем.

definition: a layer of material covering the inside of something
sentence: The coat has a warm {lining} of soft wool.
translation: У пальто тёплая подкладка из мягкой шерсти.

definition: a substance in food that living things need to grow and stay healthy
sentence: Vegetables give you every {nutrient} your body needs.
translation: Овощи дают организму все необходимые питательные вещества.

definition: a series of rulers from the same family
sentence: The {dynasty} ruled the empire for three hundred years.
translation: Династия правила империей триста лет.

definition: a large cup with straight sides and a handle, used without a saucer
sentence: She warmed her hands on a {mug} of tea.
translation: Она грела руки о кружку с чаем.

definition: one of the tiny dots that make up a picture on a screen
sentence: Each {pixel} on the screen can show millions of colours.
translation: Каждый пиксель на экране может показывать миллионы цветов.

definition: to put something into a person's body in an operation
sentence: Surgeons will {implant} a small device to steady his heart.
translation: Хирурги имплантируют небольшое устройство, чтобы стабилизировать его сердце.

definition: the activity of cooking bread, cakes and pastry in an oven
sentence: Her {baking} is famous; nobody says no to her cakes.
translation: Её выпечка знаменита: никто не отказывается от её пирогов.

definition: in a very attractive or very well done way
sentence: The garden is {beautifully} kept, with not a weed in sight.
translation: Сад содержится в прекрасном состоянии, ни одного сорняка.

definition: from or relating to the Bible, or very large
sentence: The flood was of {biblical} size and covered three valleys.
translation: Наводнение было библейских масштабов и затопило три долины.

definition: having the skill and knowledge to do something well
sentence: She is a {competent} driver but hates the motorway.
translation: Она умелый водитель, но ненавидит автомагистрали.

definition: land outside towns and cities, with fields, woods and farms
sentence: We spent Sunday walking in the {countryside} near the river.
translation: Воскресенье мы провели, гуляя по сельской местности у реки.

definition: broken pieces left after something is destroyed
sentence: The street was covered in {debris} after the explosion.
translation: После взрыва улица была усыпана обломками.

definition: relating to the size and structure of a population
sentence: The {demographic} shift means fewer children and more pensioners.
translation: Демографический сдвиг означает меньше детей и больше пенсионеров.

definition: the act of joining a school or course, or the number of people who join
sentence: {Enrollment} at the college fell by ten percent this year.
translation: Набор в колледж в этом году сократился на десять процентов.

definition: a plant like a small onion with a strong taste, used in cooking
sentence: Fry two cloves of {garlic} in olive oil.
translation: Обжарь два зубчика чеснока в оливковом масле.

definition: the feeling of being thankful
sentence: She sent flowers as a sign of her {gratitude}.
translation: Она отправила цветы в знак благодарности.

definition: a very strong illegal drug made from a poppy plant
sentence: He has been free of {heroin} for three years now.
translation: Он уже три года не употребляет героин.

definition: free time when you are not working
sentence: I spend most of my {leisure} time on my bike.
translation: Большую часть свободного времени я провожу на велосипеде.

definition: used to say that something good happened by chance
sentence: {Luckily}, I had a spare key in my pocket.
translation: К счастью, у меня в кармане был запасной ключ.

definition: Italian food made from flour and water, such as spaghetti
sentence: Boil the {pasta} for ten minutes and add the sauce.
translation: Вари пасту десять минут и добавь соус.

definition: behaving in a way that shows respect for others
sentence: It is {polite} to thank the driver when you leave the bus.
translation: Вежливо поблагодарить водителя, выходя из автобуса.

definition: the quality of being trusted to work or behave well
sentence: The car is famous for its {reliability}; it never breaks down.
translation: Машина славится своей надёжностью: она никогда не ломается.

definition: the study of religion and religious ideas
sentence: He studied {theology} before he became a journalist.
translation: Он изучал богословие, прежде чем стать журналистом.

definition: below the surface of the sea, a lake or a river
sentence: The {underwater} camera caught a shark swimming past.
translation: Подводная камера засняла проплывающую акулу.

definition: to move an organ from one body to another, or a plant to another place
sentence: Doctors will {transplant} a kidney from his sister.
translation: Врачи пересадят ему почку от сестры.

definition: a large round orange vegetable with a thick skin
sentence: We carved a face into the {pumpkin} for Halloween.
translation: Мы вырезали лицо на тыкве к Хэллоуину.

definition: meat cut very small and mixed with spices inside a thin skin
sentence: He fried a {sausage} and two eggs for breakfast.
translation: Он пожарил сосиску и два яйца на завтрак.

definition: a child whose parents are dead
sentence: The {orphan} was raised by her aunt in the city.
translation: Сироту вырастила тётя в городе.

definition: an organisation that exists to help people, not to make money
sentence: She runs a {nonprofit} that teaches children to swim.
translation: Она руководит некоммерческой организацией, которая учит детей плавать.

definition: a person who represents their country in a foreign country
sentence: The {diplomat} spent four years at the embassy in Cairo.
translation: Дипломат провёл четыре года в посольстве в Каире.

definition: to move very fast, or to make a picture bigger on a screen
sentence: Cars {zoom} past the school at twice the speed limit.
translation: Машины проносятся мимо школы вдвое быстрее разрешённой скорости.

definition: to feel very worried about something that is going to happen
sentence: I {dread} the moment when the results come out.
translation: Я со страхом жду момента, когда объявят результаты.

definition: a line of bushes growing close together along the edge of a garden or field
sentence: A thick {hedge} hides the garden from the road.
translation: Густая живая изгородь скрывает сад от дороги.

definition: a sea animal with a hard shell, ten legs and two large claws
sentence: A small {crab} ran sideways across the sand.
translation: Маленький краб побежал боком по песку.

definition: a parent of your mother or father
sentence: Every {grandparent} wants to see the children at Christmas.
translation: Каждый дедушка и каждая бабушка хотят увидеть детей на Рождество.

definition: an idea or plan that is suggested, or a statement that may be true
sentence: Buying the old mill is a risky {proposition}.
translation: Покупка старой мельницы — рискованная затея.

definition: a large round container for washing, or a small one for food
sentence: The baby splashed happily in the {tub}.
translation: Малыш радостно плескался в ванночке.

definition: to move or develop more slowly than others
sentence: The smaller towns {lag} behind the capital in internet speed.
translation: Маленькие города отстают от столицы по скорости интернета.

definition: a long narrow hole dug in the ground, especially for soldiers to hide in
sentence: The soldiers lived in a muddy {trench} for months.
translation: Солдаты месяцами жили в грязном окопе.

definition: a condition that makes you ill when you eat or touch a certain thing
sentence: She has an {allergy} to nuts and carries medicine everywhere.
translation: У неё аллергия на орехи, и она всюду носит с собой лекарство.

definition: to produce young, or to make a copy of something
sentence: Rabbits {reproduce} so fast that the farm is full of them.
translation: Кролики размножаются так быстро, что ферма полна ими.

definition: a sharp curved nail on the foot of an animal or bird
sentence: The cat dug a {claw} into my arm when I lifted it.
translation: Кошка вонзила коготь мне в руку, когда я её поднял.

definition: something that goes well with another thing and makes it better
sentence: A dry white wine is the perfect {complement} to fish.
translation: Сухое белое вино — идеальное дополнение к рыбе.

definition: a sudden bright light or burst of flame, or a signal light
sentence: The sailors fired a {flare} so the rescue boat could find them.
translation: Моряки запустили сигнальную ракету, чтобы спасательная лодка их нашла.

definition: to think about something seriously for a long time
sentence: I'm {contemplating} moving to the coast next year.
translation: Я подумываю переехать на побережье в следующем году.

definition: something that limits what you can do
sentence: Time is the main {constraint} on this project.
translation: Главное ограничение в этом проекте — время.

definition: to work together with others on a project
sentence: The two labs {collaborate} on research into new batteries.
translation: Две лаборатории сотрудничают в исследовании новых батарей.

definition: a person who owns businesses and supports private ownership
sentence: The old {capitalist} owned half the factories in the valley.
translation: Старый капиталист владел половиной заводов в долине.

definition: to press skin tightly between finger and thumb
sentence: Stop it, you {pinch} too hard and it hurts.
translation: Перестань, ты щиплешь слишком сильно, и это больно.

definition: the sending of messages over long distances by phone, radio or internet
sentence: The {telecommunication} company laid cables across the whole island.
translation: Телекоммуникационная компания проложила кабели по всему острову.

definition: to grow well and be healthy or successful
sentence: My plants {flourish} on the balcony in summer.
translation: Летом мои растения на балконе прекрасно растут.

definition: talk about other people's private lives, often unkind or untrue
sentence: Office {gossip} says the manager is leaving in June.
translation: Офисные сплетни говорят, что менеджер уходит в июне.

definition: a small specialised area of business or interest that suits someone
sentence: She found her {niche} designing websites for small hotels.
translation: Она нашла свою нишу, разрабатывая сайты для маленьких отелей.

definition: to hit someone or something hard many times
sentence: Huge waves {batter} the cliffs every winter.
translation: Огромные волны бьют по скалам каждую зиму.

definition: a feeling of being extremely tired
sentence: By Friday the {fatigue} was so bad I slept twelve hours.
translation: К пятнице усталость была такой, что я проспал двенадцать часов.

definition: a work of art or craft that is the best of its kind
sentence: The painting is seen as the artist's greatest {masterpiece}.
translation: Картина считается величайшим шедевром художника.

definition: something you agree to give up in order to end an argument
sentence: The union made one {concession}: a later start for the new rules.
translation: Профсоюз пошёл на одну уступку: более поздний срок введения новых правил.

definition: to go into or through something
sentence: The cold wind seemed to {penetrate} even the thickest coat.
translation: Холодный ветер, казалось, проникал даже сквозь самое толстое пальто.

definition: complete control of a market by one company
sentence: For years the company had a {monopoly} on phone calls in the country.
translation: Долгие годы компания имела монополию на телефонную связь в стране.

definition: having a sharp taste like a lemon, or no longer fresh
sentence: The milk has gone {sour}; pour it away.
translation: Молоко прокисло, вылей его.

definition: to cause a dark mark on the skin by hitting it
sentence: Be careful not to {bruise} the peaches when you pack them.
translation: Осторожно, не помни персики, когда будешь их укладывать.

definition: a time when the sun or moon is hidden by the other
sentence: Thousands gathered on the hill to watch the solar {eclipse}.
translation: Тысячи людей собрались на холме, чтобы увидеть солнечное затмение.

definition: the wish to eat, or a strong wish for something
sentence: A long walk gives you a good {appetite} for dinner.
translation: Долгая прогулка пробуждает хороший аппетит перед ужином.

definition: to keep annoying or threatening someone
sentence: Reporters continued to {harass} the family outside their home.
translation: Журналисты продолжали донимать семью у их дома.

definition: a member of a town or city council
sentence: The {councillor} promised to fix the street lights by spring.
translation: Член городского совета пообещал починить уличные фонари к весне.

definition: a large farm where one crop such as tea, cotton or sugar is grown
sentence: The {plantation} grows tea on the slopes above the town.
translation: На плантации выращивают чай на склонах над городом.

definition: the duty to explain your actions and accept the results
sentence: The report called for more {accountability} in the police.
translation: В отчёте содержится призыв к большей подотчётности полиции.

definition: happening in or coming from the air
sentence: The {aerial} photos show how much the forest has shrunk.
translation: Снимки с воздуха показывают, насколько сократился лес.

definition: the things fired from guns, such as bullets
sentence: The soldiers ran out of {ammunition} after two hours.
translation: У солдат кончились боеприпасы через два часа.

definition: giving money or help to people in need, or kind in your judgement
sentence: She left half her fortune to {charitable} causes.
translation: Половину состояния она оставила на благотворительные цели.

definition: again and again over a long period
sentence: He {continually} interrupts me when I try to explain.
translation: Он постоянно перебивает меня, когда я пытаюсь объяснить.

definition: giving pleasure
sentence: It was an {enjoyable} evening with good food and old friends.
translation: Это был приятный вечер с хорошей едой и старыми друзьями.

definition: unusual and exciting because it comes from a far away country
sentence: The market sells {exotic} fruit I have never seen before.
translation: На рынке продают экзотические фрукты, которых я никогда не видел.

definition: the outside of a building or object
sentence: The {exterior} of the house needs new paint.
translation: Фасад дома нуждается в новой покраске.

definition: having qualities traditionally thought of as typical of women
sentence: The room was decorated in a soft {feminine} style.
translation: Комната была оформлена в мягком женственном стиле.

definition: very great anger that you cannot control
sentence: She slammed the door in {fury} and did not come back.
translation: Она в ярости хлопнула дверью и не вернулась.

definition: the deliberate killing of a whole nation or ethnic group
sentence: The court found the general guilty of {genocide}.
translation: Суд признал генерала виновным в геноциде.

definition: the town where you were born or grew up
sentence: He returned to his {hometown} to open a bakery.
translation: Он вернулся в родной город, чтобы открыть пекарню.

definition: concerned with reducing suffering and improving people's lives
sentence: {Humanitarian} aid reached the flooded villages by boat.
translation: Гуманитарная помощь добралась до затопленных деревень на лодках.

definition: the body's ability to resist a disease, or protection from punishment
sentence: The vaccine gives {immunity} for about ten years.
translation: Вакцина даёт иммунитет примерно на десять лет.

definition: the act of setting people free from control or occupation
sentence: The city celebrates its {liberation} every May.
translation: Город каждый май празднует своё освобождение.

definition: how probable it is that something will happen
sentence: In all {likelihood} the meeting will be moved again.
translation: Скорее всего, встречу снова перенесут.

definition: only one, without others
sentence: A {lone} tree stood in the middle of the field.
translation: Одинокое дерево стояло посреди поля.

definition: in the sea away from the coast, or in a foreign country for tax reasons
sentence: The {offshore} wind farm powers half the city.
translation: Морская ветряная электростанция снабжает энергией половину города.

definition: not required; you can choose whether to do it
sentence: The evening trip is {optional}, so stay at the hotel if you like.
translation: Вечерняя экскурсия по желанию, так что оставайтесь в отеле, если хотите.

definition: an open public square in a town, often with shops around it
sentence: People gather in the {plaza} every evening to talk and eat.
translation: Каждый вечер люди собираются на площади, чтобы поговорить и поесть.

definition: the state of being successful and having a lot of money
sentence: The discovery of oil brought {prosperity} to the small nation.
translation: Открытие нефти принесло маленькой стране процветание.

definition: done for pleasure in your free time, not for work
sentence: The lake is used for {recreational} boating in summer.
translation: Летом озеро используют для прогулок на лодках.

definition: relating to the quieter areas on the edge of a city
sentence: They moved to a {suburban} street with gardens and quiet roads.
translation: Они переехали на пригородную улицу с садами и тихими дорогами.

definition: very, or very badly
sentence: I am {terribly} sorry about the broken vase.
translation: Мне ужасно жаль разбитую вазу.

definition: relating to land that belongs to a country, or protecting your own area
sentence: The two countries have a {territorial} dispute over the islands.
translation: Между двумя странами есть территориальный спор из-за островов.

definition: having a gender identity different from the sex given at birth
sentence: The school changed its rules to support {transgender} students.
translation: Школа изменила свои правила, чтобы поддержать трансгендерных учеников.

definition: spoken rather than written, or relating to words
sentence: We had only a {verbal} agreement, nothing on paper.
translation: У нас была только устная договорённость, ничего на бумаге.

definition: the soft hair of sheep, or the thread or cloth made from it
sentence: The sweater is pure {wool} and very warm.
translation: Свитер из чистой шерсти и очень тёплый.

definition: the glass part of an electric light, or the round root of some plants
sentence: The {bulb} in the hall has burnt out again.
translation: Лампочка в прихожей снова перегорела.

definition: to attract someone to a place or action by offering something
sentence: Cheap flights {lure} tourists to the island all year.
translation: Дешёвые рейсы заманивают туристов на остров круглый год.

definition: to hit someone or something with the flat of your hand
sentence: Parents who {smack} their children can be fined here.
translation: Родителей, которые шлёпают детей, здесь могут оштрафовать.

definition: a woman in a secret relationship with a married man, or a woman in charge
sentence: The king's {mistress} had more power than his ministers.
translation: Любовница короля имела больше власти, чем его министры.

definition: to think something is smaller, easier or less important than it really is
sentence: Never {underestimate} how long the paperwork will take.
translation: Никогда не недооценивай, сколько времени займёт бумажная работа.

definition: a large ship that carries passengers, or a layer put inside something
sentence: The old {liner} crossed the Atlantic in five days.
translation: Старый лайнер пересекал Атлантику за пять дней.

definition: a chair with wheels for people who cannot walk
sentence: The new library has a ramp for anyone in a {wheelchair}.
translation: В новой библиотеке есть пандус для всех, кто передвигается в инвалидной коляске.

definition: to pay a company so it pays you if something is lost or damaged
sentence: You should {insure} the bike; they get stolen every week here.
translation: Тебе стоит застраховать велосипед, их здесь крадут каждую неделю.

definition: to watch over people or work to make sure it is done properly
sentence: A teacher must {supervise} the children in the pool at all times.
translation: Учитель должен постоянно присматривать за детьми в бассейне.

definition: a strong slow vehicle used on farms to pull heavy equipment
sentence: The farmer drove his {tractor} across the muddy field.
translation: Фермер вёл трактор через грязное поле.

definition: a person who fights with their fists as a sport
sentence: The {boxer} won the fight in the third round.
translation: Боксёр выиграл бой в третьем раунде.

definition: a particular area or neighbourhood
sentence: Every shop in the {locality} closes early on Sundays.
translation: Все магазины в округе закрываются рано по воскресеньям.

definition: an official body that controls an industry and makes sure it follows the rules
sentence: The {regulator} fined the bank for hiding fees from customers.
translation: Регулятор оштрафовал банк за сокрытие комиссий от клиентов.

definition: a light gentle wind
sentence: A cool {breeze} came in from the sea in the evening.
translation: Вечером с моря подул прохладный ветерок.

definition: a set of letters of one design and size used in print or on screens
sentence: Use a larger {font} so the poster can be read from far away.
translation: Используй шрифт покрупнее, чтобы плакат читался издалека.

definition: not tidy or not clean, or hard and unpleasant to deal with
sentence: His room is so {messy} that you cannot see the floor.
translation: В его комнате такой беспорядок, что пола не видно.

definition: an amount that is more than what is needed
sentence: We have a {surplus} of apples, take some home.
translation: У нас избыток яблок, забери немного домой.

definition: a story that people repeat but that may not be true
sentence: There's a {rumour} that the cafe is closing down.
translation: Ходит слух, что кафе закрывается.

definition: to force people to leave their home, or to take the place of something
sentence: The floods will {displace} thousands of families this year.
translation: Наводнения в этом году вынудят тысячи семей покинуть дома.

definition: to tie someone or something tightly, or to force someone by law or promise
sentence: They used rope to {bind} the boxes to the roof of the car.
translation: Они верёвкой привязали коробки к крыше машины.

definition: a device that finds or measures something such as smoke or metal
sentence: The smoke {detector} went off when the toast burned.
translation: Датчик дыма сработал, когда подгорел тост.

definition: the work of repairing and improving an old building
sentence: The hotel is closed for {renovation} until next spring.
translation: Отель закрыт на ремонт до следующей весны.

definition: a very quick and not complete look at something
sentence: I caught a {glimpse} of her in the crowd and lost her.
translation: Я мельком увидел её в толпе и потерял из виду.

definition: a word that describes an action or state, such as run or be
sentence: In the sentence 'She sings', the {verb} is 'sings'.
translation: В предложении «She sings» глагол — «sings».

definition: to get rid of something, especially rubbish or something dangerous
sentence: You cannot {dispose} of old batteries in the normal bin.
translation: Старые батарейки нельзя выбрасывать в обычное ведро.

definition: a person who plans an event, or a tool that keeps things in order
sentence: The {organizer} of the festival thanked all the volunteers.
translation: Организатор фестиваля поблагодарил всех волонтёров.

definition: a person in a group or company who knows things that others do not
sentence: An {insider} told the newspaper about the planned job cuts.
translation: Человек изнутри компании рассказал газете о планируемых сокращениях.

definition: to try to get someone's love, support or business
sentence: The shop offers free coffee to {woo} new customers.
translation: Магазин предлагает бесплатный кофе, чтобы привлечь новых клиентов.

definition: the money a business takes in a period, or how fast its staff leave
sentence: The company's {turnover} doubled after the new product launched.
translation: Оборот компании удвоился после запуска нового продукта.

definition: the line of hair above each eye
sentence: She raised one {eyebrow} when she heard the price.
translation: Она подняла бровь, услышав цену.

definition: a field of grass and wild flowers
sentence: Cows grazed quietly in the {meadow} by the river.
translation: Коровы тихо паслись на лугу у реки.

definition: to do something again and again to get better at it
sentence: You need to {practise} the piano every day to improve.
translation: Нужно упражняться на пианино каждый день, чтобы стать лучше.

definition: the set of methods used to do a piece of work or research
sentence: The report explains the {methodology} behind the survey.
translation: В отчёте объясняется методология, на которой основан опрос.

definition: a small V-shaped cut in an edge, or a level on a scale
sentence: He cut a {notch} in the stick for every day on the island.
translation: Он делал зарубку на палке за каждый день на острове.

definition: a small green fruit like a lemon with a sour juice
sentence: Squeeze a {lime} over the fish before serving.
translation: Выжми лайм на рыбу перед подачей.

definition: a long case holding the seeds of a plant such as peas or beans
sentence: Open the {pod} and push the peas out with your thumb.
translation: Раскрой стручок и выдави горошины большим пальцем.

definition: a flower on a tree or bush, especially one that produces fruit
sentence: The cherry {blossom} lasts only a week or two in April.
translation: Цветение вишни длится всего неделю-две в апреле.

definition: responsible for your actions and expected to explain them
sentence: Ministers are {accountable} to parliament for their decisions.
translation: Министры отвечают перед парламентом за свои решения.

definition: public support for an idea or a group of people
sentence: Her {advocacy} for clean rivers won her a national prize.
translation: Её публичная поддержка чистых рек принесла ей национальную премию.

definition: the period and situation that follow a bad event
sentence: In the {aftermath} of the storm, the town had no power for a week.
translation: После бури город неделю оставался без электричества.

definition: angry behaviour that may hurt people
sentence: The dog showed no {aggression} towards the children.
translation: Собака не проявляла агрессии к детям.

definition: used to say that a claim can be supported with good reasons
sentence: She is {arguably} the best swimmer the club has ever had.
translation: Она, пожалуй, лучшая пловчиха за всю историю клуба.

definition: saying exactly what you think without trying to be polite
sentence: To be {blunt}, your plan is not going to work.
translation: Скажу прямо: твой план не сработает.

definition: a French white wine with bubbles, drunk at parties
sentence: We opened a bottle of {champagne} to celebrate the news.
translation: Мы открыли бутылку шампанского, чтобы отметить новость.

definition: a hard shiny metal coating used on cars and taps
sentence: The old motorbike still has its original {chrome} parts.
translation: У старого мотоцикла до сих пор оригинальные хромированные детали.

definition: the quality of being clear and easy to understand or see
sentence: The teacher explained the rule with great {clarity}.
translation: Учитель объяснил правило очень ясно.

definition: meant to be kept secret
sentence: This report is {confidential}; do not share it outside the team.
translation: Этот отчёт конфиденциальный, не передавайте его за пределы команды.

definition: the organisation of different people or parts so they work well together
sentence: Good {coordination} between the hospitals saved many lives.
translation: Хорошая координация между больницами спасла много жизней.

definition: the freedom to decide what to do, or care in keeping things private
sentence: Staff may give refunds at their own {discretion}.
translation: Сотрудники могут возвращать деньги по своему усмотрению.

definition: thick cloud close to the ground that makes it hard to see
sentence: The airport closed for three hours because of thick {fog}.
translation: Аэропорт закрылся на три часа из-за густого тумана.

definition: flat and level, parallel to the ground
sentence: Draw a {horizontal} line across the top of the page.
translation: Проведи горизонтальную линию вверху страницы.

definition: friendly and generous treatment of guests
sentence: Thank you for your warm {hospitality} during our stay.
translation: Спасибо за ваше тёплое гостеприимство во время нашего пребывания.

definition: one by one, separately from the others
sentence: The teacher spoke to each student {individually} after the test.
translation: После контрольной учитель поговорил с каждым учеником отдельно.

definition: in a way that cannot be avoided
sentence: Prices {inevitably} rise when the harvest is poor.
translation: Цены неизбежно растут, когда урожай плохой.

definition: the ability to read and write
sentence: The charity runs {literacy} classes for adults in the village.
translation: Благотворительная организация ведёт в деревне курсы грамотности для взрослых.

definition: small amounts of water in the air, on a surface or in something
sentence: The {moisture} in the basement is ruining the old books.
translation: Сырость в подвале портит старые книги.

definition: the number of deaths in a period or place, or the state of being mortal
sentence: Child {mortality} has fallen sharply in the last fifty years.
translation: Детская смертность резко снизилась за последние пятьдесят лет.

definition: continuing for a long time, or refusing to give up
sentence: A {persistent} cough should be checked by a doctor.
translation: Непроходящий кашель должен проверить врач.

definition: oil found deep in the ground, used to make fuel and plastic
sentence: The country's wealth comes almost entirely from {petroleum}.
translation: Богатство страны почти целиком основано на нефти.

definition: the process of developing gradually from one stage to the next
sentence: The film shows the {progression} of the disease over ten years.
translation: Фильм показывает развитие болезни за десять лет.

definition: a strong light aimed at one spot, or a lot of public attention
sentence: The singer stood alone in the {spotlight} on the dark stage.
translation: Певица стояла одна в луче прожектора на тёмной сцене.

definition: serious and strict, not friendly
sentence: The {stern} judge did not smile once during the trial.
translation: Суровый судья ни разу не улыбнулся за время процесса.

definition: extremely good
sentence: We had a {terrific} time at the beach yesterday.
translation: Мы вчера отлично провели время на пляже.

definition: the quality of being open about what you do so people can check it
sentence: The new law demands more {transparency} in party funding.
translation: Новый закон требует большей прозрачности в финансировании партий.

definition: without a paid job
sentence: He has been {unemployed} since the factory closed in March.
translation: Он без работы с тех пор, как в марте закрылся завод.

definition: a mountain with a hole at the top that throws out hot rock and gas
sentence: The {volcano} last erupted more than two hundred years ago.
translation: Вулкан последний раз извергался больше двухсот лет назад.

definition: a large group of soldiers that forms part of a larger army unit
sentence: The {battalion} marched twenty miles before dark.
translation: Батальон прошёл двадцать миль до наступления темноты.

definition: a small round green seed eaten as a vegetable
sentence: She dropped a {pea} and the dog ate it at once.
translation: Она уронила горошину, и собака тут же её съела.

definition: a person who introduces a television or radio programme
sentence: The {presenter} welcomed the guests and read the first question.
translation: Ведущий поприветствовал гостей и зачитал первый вопрос.

definition: a collection of pieces of music, writing or film put together
sentence: The band released a {compilation} of their best songs.
translation: Группа выпустила сборник своих лучших песен.

definition: something that protects against harm or reduces the effect of a shock
sentence: Savings act as a {buffer} when you lose your job.
translation: Сбережения служат подушкой безопасности, когда теряешь работу.

definition: to have a strong wish to achieve something
sentence: Many young players {aspire} to play for the national team.
translation: Многие молодые игроки мечтают играть за сборную.

definition: a house or place where someone lives, used in formal language
sentence: The old stone {dwelling} had no electricity or running water.
translation: В старом каменном жилище не было ни электричества, ни водопровода.

definition: the number 70
sentence: My grandmother is {seventy} and still swims every morning.
translation: Моей бабушке семьдесят, и она всё ещё плавает каждое утро.

definition: a warm knitted piece of clothing for the top half of the body
sentence: Put on a {sweater}; the evenings are cold here.
translation: Надень свитер, вечера здесь холодные.

definition: to make something seem bigger or better than it really is
sentence: He {exaggerates} every story he tells about his trips.
translation: Он преувеличивает каждую историю о своих поездках.

definition: an important discovery or success after a long effort
sentence: Switching to mornings was a {breakthrough} for my running.
translation: Переход на утренние пробежки стал для меня прорывом.

definition: a person who is walking in a street rather than driving
sentence: A {pedestrian} was hit by a cyclist on the crossing.
translation: На переходе велосипедист сбил пешехода.

definition: to look through a shop, book or website without a clear plan
sentence: I like to {browse} the shelves of old bookshops on holiday.
translation: В отпуске я люблю рассматривать полки старых книжных магазинов.

definition: to decay slowly and become bad and soft
sentence: Apples left on the ground will {rot} within a week.
translation: Яблоки, оставленные на земле, сгниют за неделю.

definition: a thick clear substance like jelly, used on hair or skin
sentence: He puts {gel} in his hair to keep it in place.
translation: Он наносит гель на волосы, чтобы они держали форму.

definition: a small plant with purple flowers, or a bluish-purple colour
sentence: A tiny {violet} grew between the stones of the path.
translation: Маленькая фиалка росла между камнями дорожки.

definition: the daughter of your brother or sister
sentence: My {niece} is starting university this autumn.
translation: Моя племянница этой осенью поступает в университет.

definition: a group of related plants or animals that contains several species
sentence: Lions and tigers belong to the same {genus}.
translation: Львы и тигры принадлежат к одному роду.

definition: to hit your hands together to show you liked something
sentence: The audience began to {clap} before the song had finished.
