translation: Зрители начали хлопать ещё до того, как песня закончилась.

definition: a person who cuts up and sells meat
sentence: The {butcher} on the corner sells the best sausages in town.
translation: Мясник на углу продаёт лучшие колбаски в городе.

definition: to move in a circle around a central point
sentence: The planets {revolve} around the sun.
translation: Планеты вращаются вокруг Солнца.

definition: an object made by people long ago that is of historical interest
sentence: Every {artifact} from the dig is numbered and photographed.
translation: Каждый артефакт с раскопок нумеруется и фотографируется.

definition: a friend who shares your work or struggle, especially a soldier or party member
sentence: He lost his closest {comrade} in the last week of the war.
translation: Он потерял ближайшего товарища в последнюю неделю войны.

definition: a person who watches an event, especially a sports match
sentence: Every {spectator} stood up when the home team scored.
translation: Все зрители встали, когда забила домашняя команда.

definition: a cover for a box, pot or container
sentence: Put the {lid} on the pan so the rice cooks faster.
translation: Накрой кастрюлю крышкой, чтобы рис сварился быстрее.

definition: using strong or violent methods to support a cause
sentence: The {militant} group refused to take part in the talks.
translation: Воинствующая группировка отказалась участвовать в переговорах.

definition: a young male horse
sentence: The {colt} ran beside its mother across the field.
translation: Жеребёнок бежал рядом с матерью через поле.

definition: competition between people or groups who want the same thing
sentence: The {rivalry} between the two schools goes back a hundred years.
translation: Соперничество между двумя школами длится уже сто лет.

definition: progress or improvement, or promotion to a higher position
sentence: The new lab is a big {advancement} for cancer research.
translation: Новая лаборатория — большой шаг вперёд для исследований рака.

definition: to be extremely good at something
sentence: She did not {excel} at school, but she was a brilliant cook.
translation: В школе она не блистала, но была великолепным поваром.

definition: a piece of iron that pulls other metal objects towards it
sentence: The fridge {magnet} holds the shopping list in place.
translation: Магнит на холодильнике держит список покупок.

definition: bad for you, or working against you
sentence: The drug can have {adverse} effects on the heart.
translation: Препарат может оказывать неблагоприятное воздействие на сердце.

definition: for a short time
sentence: Sit down and rest {awhile} before you go on.
translation: Присядь и отдохни немного, прежде чем идти дальше.

definition: relating to mobile phones, or to the cells of living things
sentence: The village finally has {cellular} coverage after ten years.
translation: В деревне наконец появилась сотовая связь спустя десять лет.

definition: a large sea fish with white flesh that is eaten as food
sentence: Fish and chips are usually made with {cod}.
translation: Рыбу с картошкой обычно делают из трески.

definition: professional help and advice for people with personal problems
sentence: After the accident she had {counseling} for six months.
translation: После аварии она полгода ходила к психологу.

definition: causing great damage or harm
sentence: The {destructive} storm left thousands without homes.
translation: Разрушительная буря оставила тысячи людей без крова.

definition: the act of saying goodbye, especially for a long time
sentence: The team gave their coach an emotional {farewell} after the final.
translation: Команда трогательно попрощалась с тренером после финала.

definition: having a great liking for someone or something
sentence: She is very {fond} of her old dog.
translation: Она очень любит свою старую собаку.

definition: not showing good sense; silly
sentence: It was {foolish} to leave the car unlocked in the city.
translation: Было глупо оставить машину незапертой в городе.

definition: the state of being kept in prison as a punishment
sentence: The judge gave him three years' {imprisonment} for the robbery.
translation: Судья дал ему три года тюремного заключения за ограбление.

definition: legally responsible, or likely to do or suffer something
sentence: The owner is {liable} for any damage caused by the dog.
translation: Владелец несёт ответственность за любой ущерб, причинённый собакой.

definition: the middle of a period, activity or group
sentence: The phone rang in the {midst} of the meeting.
translation: Телефон зазвонил в самый разгар совещания.

definition: great unhappiness or suffering
sentence: The long illness brought {misery} to the whole family.
translation: Долгая болезнь принесла страдания всей семье.

definition: a small soft green plant that grows on stones, trees and wet ground
sentence: Thick green {moss} covered the north side of the rock.
translation: Густой зелёный мох покрывал северную сторону скалы.

definition: in a hopeful or approving way, or used to stress a statement
sentence: The town reacted {positively} to the plan for a new park.
translation: Город положительно отнёсся к плану нового парка.

definition: suddenly and by a large amount, or in a harsh way
sentence: Sales fell {sharply} after the price rise.
translation: Продажи резко упали после повышения цен.

definition: in an honest way that shows you really mean it
sentence: I {sincerely} hope you feel better soon.
translation: Я искренне надеюсь, что тебе скоро станет лучше.

definition: support and agreement among people with a shared aim
sentence: Workers across the country stopped work in {solidarity} with the miners.
translation: Рабочие по всей стране прекратили работу в знак солидарности с шахтёрами.

definition: not explained by the laws of nature, like ghosts and magic
sentence: The village is full of stories about {supernatural} events.
translation: Деревня полна историй о сверхъестественных событиях.

definition: the number 13
sentence: There were {thirteen} people at the table, which worried my aunt.
translation: За столом было тринадцать человек, что встревожило мою тётю.

definition: a huge stone building with a square base and sloping sides meeting at a point
sentence: The oldest {pyramid} in Egypt was built nearly five thousand years ago.
translation: Самая старая пирамида в Египте построена почти пять тысяч лет назад.

definition: control of people or things in a clever or dishonest way
sentence: The court found evidence of {manipulation} of the test results.
translation: Суд нашёл доказательства подтасовки результатов тестов.

definition: strongly supporting one party or side without fair judgement
sentence: The newspaper's {partisan} reporting made many readers angry.
translation: Предвзятые репортажи газеты разозлили многих читателей.

definition: to cut violently with a sharp blade, or to reduce greatly
sentence: The shop will {slash} prices by half in the January sale.
translation: На январской распродаже магазин снизит цены вдвое.

definition: a question, especially one asking for information or expressing doubt
sentence: Send any {query} about the booking to the hotel's email.
translation: Любой вопрос о бронировании направляйте на электронную почту отеля.

definition: a game or short test in which people answer questions
sentence: Our team won the pub {quiz} by a single point.
translation: Наша команда выиграла викторину в пабе с перевесом в одно очко.

definition: the son of your son or daughter
sentence: Her {grandson} visits every Sunday and fixes her computer.
translation: Её внук приходит каждое воскресенье и чинит ей компьютер.

definition: a person who plays football, especially as a job
sentence: The young {footballer} signed for the club at sixteen.
translation: Молодой футболист подписал контракт с клубом в шестнадцать лет.

definition: something that happens, or how often it happens
sentence: Snow in May is a rare {occurrence} in this part of the country.
translation: Снег в мае — редкое явление в этой части страны.

definition: a cover made of rubber that a man uses during sex for protection
sentence: The clinic gives out a free {condom} to anyone who asks.
translation: Клиника бесплатно выдаёт презерватив всем желающим.

definition: serious written or spoken discussion of a subject
sentence: Political {discourse} has become angrier in recent years.
translation: Политическая дискуссия в последние годы стала злее.

definition: words printed under a picture to explain it
sentence: The {caption} under the photo named everyone in the team.
translation: В подписи под фотографией были названы все члены команды.

definition: a violent attempt by a group of people to change their government or leader
sentence: The peasants rose in {revolt} against the new taxes.
translation: Крестьяне подняли бунт против новых налогов.

definition: a small electric light you carry in your hand, or a burning stick
sentence: Take a {torch}; the path through the woods has no lights.
translation: Возьми фонарик, на тропе через лес нет освещения.

definition: a teacher who works with one student or a small group
sentence: Her parents hired a {tutor} to help her with maths.
translation: Родители наняли ей репетитора по математике.

definition: a device that explodes in the sky with coloured lights and loud bangs
sentence: A {firework} lit the sky red as the clock struck midnight.
translation: Фейерверк окрасил небо в красный, когда часы пробили полночь.

definition: to go around something instead of through it, or to avoid a rule
sentence: The new road will {bypass} the town centre completely.
translation: Новая дорога будет полностью обходить центр города.

definition: unfair treatment or a situation that is not fair
sentence: The film tells the story of a great {injustice} done to a young man.
translation: Фильм рассказывает о великой несправедливости по отношению к молодому человеку.

definition: to see or show the difference between things
sentence: Young children cannot always {differentiate} between dreams and reality.
translation: Маленькие дети не всегда могут отличить сон от реальности.

definition: a person who betrays their country, group or friends
sentence: The general was shot as a {traitor} after the war.
translation: Генерала расстреляли как предателя после войны.

definition: to drink something slowly in very small amounts
sentence: She sat by the window to {sip} her coffee and watch the rain.
translation: Она сидела у окна, потягивая кофе и глядя на дождь.

definition: to protect something from harm or loss
sentence: New rules will {safeguard} the savings of small investors.
translation: Новые правила защитят сбережения мелких инвесторов.

definition: a long piece of food like pasta, often served in soup
sentence: Add the {noodles} to the soup two minutes before serving.
translation: Добавь лапшу в суп за две минуты до подачи.

definition: to stop someone or something from moving or doing harm
sentence: Two officers had to {restrain} the angry fan.
translation: Двум полицейским пришлось удерживать разъярённого болельщика.

definition: a word that ends with the same sound as another, or a short poem
sentence: The children learned a {rhyme} about the days of the week.
translation: Дети выучили стишок про дни недели.

definition: a deep spoon for ice cream or sugar, or the amount it holds
sentence: Two {scoops} of ice cream, please, one chocolate and one vanilla.
translation: Две ложки мороженого, пожалуйста, шоколадного и ванильного.

definition: three or more musical notes played together
sentence: He can play only three {chords} on the guitar, but he sings well.
translation: Он знает всего три аккорда на гитаре, но хорошо поёт.

definition: a covered area at the entrance of a house
sentence: We sat on the {porch} and watched the sun go down.
translation: Мы сидели на крыльце и смотрели, как садится солнце.

definition: to happen at the same time as something else
sentence: My birthday {coincides} with the first day of the holiday.
translation: Мой день рождения совпадает с первым днём отпуска.

definition: to continue doing something even though it is difficult
sentence: If the pain {persists}, see a doctor.
translation: Если боль не проходит, сходи к врачу.

definition: to go and bring back someone or something
sentence: Could you {fetch} the kids from school at three?
translation: Можешь забрать детей из школы в три?

definition: a person who has more than a million pounds or dollars
sentence: He became a {millionaire} by selling his app to a big company.
translation: Он стал миллионером, продав своё приложение крупной компании.

definition: a person whose job is making things from wood
sentence: A {carpenter} built the bookshelves to fit the whole wall.
translation: Плотник сделал книжные полки во всю стену.

definition: to become hard or solid, or to become less kind
sentence: Leave the glue overnight so it can {harden} fully.
translation: Оставь клей на ночь, чтобы он полностью затвердел.

definition: the crime of killing a person
sentence: Police are treating the death as a {homicide}.
translation: Полиция рассматривает эту смерть как убийство.

definition: things stolen during a war, a riot or a robbery
sentence: The thieves hid the {loot} in an empty garage.
translation: Воры спрятали награбленное в пустом гараже.

definition: a herb with grey-green leaves used in cooking, or a very wise person
sentence: Fry the onions with a few leaves of {sage}.
translation: Обжарь лук с несколькими листьями шалфея.

definition: a Mexican food: a flat bread with meat inside, folded in half
sentence: I had a fish {taco} with lime and chilli.
translation: Я съел тако с рыбой, лаймом и чили.

definition: to make someone suffer something unpleasant
sentence: The storm will {inflict} serious damage on the coast.
translation: Шторм нанесёт серьёзный ущерб побережью.

definition: a large church with buildings where monks or nuns live or lived
sentence: The {abbey} was built by monks in the twelfth century.
translation: Аббатство построили монахи в двенадцатом веке.

definition: the quality of being believed and trusted
sentence: The minister lost all {credibility} after the lie was discovered.
translation: Министр потерял всякое доверие после того, как ложь раскрылась.

definition: very seriously, or in a way that judges carefully
sentence: Three passengers were {critically} injured in the crash.
translation: Трое пассажиров получили в аварии критические травмы.

definition: the number 14
sentence: She was {fourteen} when she wrote her first song.
translation: Ей было четырнадцать, когда она написала первую песню.

definition: the branch of maths that deals with lines, angles, shapes and space
sentence: In {geometry} we learned to measure the angles of a triangle.
translation: На геометрии мы научились измерять углы треугольника.

definition: extremely large in size or amount
sentence: The park is {immense}, you can walk for hours.
translation: Парк огромный, можно гулять часами.

definition: the idea that your actions in this life decide what happens to you later
sentence: He believes in {karma}, so he always helps strangers.
translation: Он верит в карму, поэтому всегда помогает незнакомцам.

definition: all people, considered as one group
sentence: The discovery of fire changed the history of {mankind}.
translation: Открытие огня изменило историю человечества.

definition: the process of making a map of something, or of showing how things relate
sentence: The {mapping} of the sea floor took the ship three years.
translation: Картирование морского дна заняло у судна три года.

definition: having no purpose or sense
sentence: It is {pointless} to argue with him when he is tired.
translation: Бессмысленно спорить с ним, когда он устал.

definition: the state of being near to something
sentence: The hotel's {proximity} to the station is its main advantage.
translation: Близость отеля к вокзалу — его главное преимущество.

definition: the feeling of being unhappy
sentence: There was {sadness} in her voice when she spoke of her old home.
translation: В её голосе звучала грусть, когда она говорила о старом доме.

definition: choosing carefully only the best or most suitable
sentence: The school is very {selective} and takes one child in ten.
translation: Школа очень избирательна и принимает одного ребёнка из десяти.

definition: bright and smooth, reflecting light
sentence: He polished the car until it was {shiny} all over.
translation: Он полировал машину, пока она вся не заблестела.

definition: a political system in which the state owns major industries and shares wealth
sentence: Under {socialism}, the mines and railways belonged to the state.
translation: При социализме шахты и железные дороги принадлежали государству.

definition: causing worry and tension
sentence: Moving house is one of the most {stressful} things you can do.
translation: Переезд — одно из самых стрессовых событий в жизни.

definition: a person who steals
sentence: A {thief} took my bag while I was buying a ticket.
translation: Вор утащил мою сумку, пока я покупал билет.

definition: certainly; without any doubt
sentence: She is {undoubtedly} the best teacher in the school.
translation: Она, несомненно, лучший учитель в школе.

definition: every year, or once a year
sentence: The rent goes up {yearly} by about three percent.
translation: Арендная плата растёт ежегодно примерно на три процента.
